verdict.rationale: The docs say Financial Connections instantly verifies bank accounts for ACH Direct Debit payments. They also document an 'instant' verification mode with no manual entry and no micro-deposit fallback, and say users stay on session instead of locating account and routing numbers. A beta integrator corroborates using it for instant account verification on ACH payments after moving from Plaid Auth. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the returned verified account/routing numbers or tokenized payment-method object a developer receives.
